assertionContract.success: Exact equality on every listed projection field, including all array contents. Unlisted fields require separate tests.
assertionContract.activityTimings: Map values projected from ActivityTiming objects to [startMinute, finishMinute] tuples.
assertionContract.warningCodes: Unique validationWarnings[].code sorted ordinally; messages and entity IDs tested separately.
assertionContract.bindings: For each named activity extract bindingDependencyIds and bindingEarliestStart from explanationPaths.
assertionContract.errors: Exact sorted arrays of code, path, entityId and relatedIds; message text is not asserted.
assertionContract.comparison: Build ComparisonRequest from shared baseline/incident/limits/currency and explicit scenario IDs of referenced recovery cases. Compare per-option metrics with corresponding case.
assertionContract.costInputCases: Call parseRecoveryCost(costDraft,currency); compare exact success value or projected errors. Blank is null; explicit zero is numeric zero.
assertionContract.briefCases: Construct referenced ComparisonRequest, copy alternatives and explicitly select the indicated option, then buildDecisionBrief with supplied metadata. Compare the named projection; verify all snapshots remain immutable.
